audio.text: Why can't I see my biology course on my schedule?

options: Biology is taught in the new science building across the street.
Yes, it meets on Monday mornings.
I can see the lake from my window.
Maybe the registration didn't go through; check your email.

why.en: "Why" → a possible reason and a suggestion. A gives a place; C repeats "see" literally; B answers "Yes" to a "why" question.
why.tr: "Why" → olası bir neden ve öneri. A yer söylüyor; C "see" kelimesini gerçek anlamıyla tekrar ediyor; B "why" sorusuna "Yes" diyor.
why.es: "Why" → una posible razón y una sugerencia. A da un lugar; C repite "see" en sentido literal; B responde "Yes" a una pregunta con "why".
